items.title: Everyone in China recognizes Gucci. That's the problem
items.summary: Critical-angle analysis: Gucci's near-universal brand recognition in China has become a liability rather than an asset, since familiarity has not translated into store traffic; Q3 2026 directly-operated store sales fell 9% on weaker mainland traffic. Argues Gucci needs a clearer point of view, not just recognizability, to win back Chinese shoppers.

items.title: Earnings call transcript: Kering Q3 2026 shares sink as Gucci recovery lags
items.summary: Critical-angle background (kept for context, near edge of freshness window): Kering Q3 2026 group revenue fell 1% comparably; Gucci sales down 6% comparably with retail down 9%, management citing persistent traffic weakness in mainland China. Kering raised its 2026 net store-closure target to at least 125 from 100 and plans to cut ~EUR 1bn of leather-goods inventory by year-end.

items.title: Actor Park Bo-gum appointed as Gucci's global brand ambassador
items.summary: English-language StarNews coverage confirming Park Bo-gum's Nov 5 appointment as Gucci global brand ambassador, part of Gucci's push to rebuild store traffic and desirability in East Asia using a trusted, broadly appealing local face.

items.title: Park Bo-gum Becomes the 'Gucci Prince': A New Global Chapter
items.summary: Profile piece framing Park Bo-gum's new Gucci ambassadorship as opening 'a new global chapter,' noting it adds to a luxury portfolio that already includes Omega, and ties his appointment to Gucci's broader East Asia visibility strategy under Demna.

items.title: グッチ、マライア・キャリーを起用した新たなホリデーキャンペーンを発表
items.summary: Japanese trade coverage of Gucci's 2026 holiday campaign featuring Mariah Carey in Demna-directed looks and the new Starlet handbag line, part of the brand's festive marketing push.

items.title: グッチの新型バッグ「グッチ NY トートバッグ」が登場！ 伊勢丹新宿店で「GucciCore」ポップアップを開催
items.summary: GucciCore pop-up at Isetan Shinjuku (Nov 4-10) launched the new Gucci NY Tote Bag, inspired by the brand's New York heritage; part of the GucciCore campaign shot by Peter Funch rolling out through November across Japan and Korea flagship stores.

items.title: 뉴욕의 맛 듬뿍, '구찌 코어' 캠페인 공개
items.summary: Korean fashion-trade coverage of the GucciCore campaign shot by Peter Funch in New York, combining everyday wardrobe basics with Italian tailoring cues; rollout continues through November to Gucci Cheongdam and other Korean stores plus gucci.com.

items.title: 古驰关店百家却业绩转正？Demna首秀+关店125家，3个维度说清+FAQ
items.summary: Templated Weibo explainer-style account post covering Demna's La Famiglia debut, Kering's 125-store 2026 closure plan (up from 100), and a claim that declines are 'stabilizing rather than reversing' post-ReconKering; near-identical recurring post titles/account pattern across many dates suggests templated/bulk content -- treated as low-confidence buzz signal per bot-filter guidance. No visible engagement counts on the post itself.

items.title: 博主吐槽古驰微博开屏广告
items.summary: Critical-angle community/SNS chatter: a digital-marketing blogger criticizes the production quality/design of a Gucci splash (open-screen) ad running on Weibo, featuring a model in a holiday-themed grey fur coat holding a Gucci bag; framed as consumer annoyance with brand's paid-ad execution rather than product sentiment. No like/comment/repost counts visible via search snippet.

items.title: 박보검 구찌 오늘자 얼굴...jpg
items.summary: Korean community thread sharing photos of Park Bo-gum at the Gucci-sponsored LACMA Art+Film Gala; comments are overwhelmingly positive and focused on his appearance rather than the brand itself. 35,220 views, 148 comments.

items.title: 구찌 시계 장단점(인증)
items.summary: Korean watch-enthusiast gallery thread discussing pros/cons of a Gucci watch model with an authenticity verification photo; mixed/neutral tone focused on finishing quality and price-to-quality assessment rather than brand hype. Exact day unconfirmed (archive-indexed), kept as a rare non-ambassador community data point since Gucci-specific community threads are otherwise scarce today.

items.title: 报道称古驰多款包袋、成衣大幅降价，降幅最高超 40%，奢侈品高价泡沫开始破裂了吗？
items.summary: Critical-angle Zhihu question thread (title itself is the signal) asking whether reports of Gucci slashing prices on multiple bags and ready-to-wear by up to 40%+ signal the bursting of the 'luxury high-price bubble'; indicates active Chinese community skepticism about Gucci's pricing power and brand value. Exact post date not confirmed via snippet; question remains active in search results as of today.

items.title: The last reliable luxury shoppers are retreating in China
items.summary: Critical-angle regional wire coverage (near edge of freshness window, kept for context): Hermes and Cartier sales in mainland China fell double-digits in August-September; Gucci Q3 sales fell 6%, worse than analyst expectations, hurt by weak China consumption, Beijing's scrutiny of offshore wealth, and a 'quiet luxury' shift among younger shoppers away from logo-driven status purchases.
